svg.title: Hob crew lineup
svg.desc: Seven launch Hob Classes and the U2 Peeper, with silhouette tests

text.font-family: Fredoka, 'Baloo 2', Nunito, 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif

svg.text: Hob crew: seven Classes at launch
The hat family is the Class. The blue scarf is the team. The Peeper joins in Update 2. Named Hobs (sheet 22) vary inside their hat family.
